channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Sweden confirms Russian drone buzzed French aircraft carrier in Malmö
item.description: The Swedish military confirmed Friday that a drone jammed near a French aircraft carrier this week was Russian as France slammed the spy attempt as a "ridiculous provocation".

item.title: Macron urges diplomacy, says France not involved in US strikes on Iran
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron told an emergency defence council he chaired late on Saturday that diplomacy must prevail to calm the conflict pitting the US and Israel against Iran.

item.title: On the Agenda: What’s happening in France this week
item.description: International Women’s Day marches, an important presidential speech, a key court ruling and a busy week for sport and TV.

item.title: OPINION: The death of Quentin Deranque will tilt France's elections
item.description: Two weeks after the death of Far Right activist Quentin Deranque in Lyon, John Lichfield looks at the political fallout of the death of this previously unknown figure, and how it will affect France's upcoming elections.

item.title: Citizenship, Spring, and the mystery of Ç — 6 essential articles for life in France
item.description: How to apply for French citizenship, what you need to know about visitor visas and what you risk by overstaying your welcome if you don’t have one, the cost of visiting the ER in France, and a brief history of the letter Ç - here are the latest must-reads for life in France.

item.title: French Word of the Day: Taupe
item.description: It's no spoiler to say that this French word might come up at some point if you're hooked on the spy drama Le Bureau des Légendes.

item.title: Everything that changes in France in March 2026
item.description: From municipal elections to a new parcel tax and an increase in vehicle registration, here is what is on the agenda for March 2026 in France.

item.title: Air France cancels Beirut, Dubai and Riyadh flights amid Iran crisis
item.description: Air France cancelled all scheduled flights to Beirut, Dubai and Riyadh on Sunday as a result of Israeli-US strikes on Iran and Tehran's retaliation, the airline said in a statement.

item.title: 'It's not just a piece of paper, I want to belong in France' - rejected citizenship applicants speak out
item.description: France's new tougher rules on French citizenship have seen an increasing number of people rejected on economic grounds - including young people who have spent almost their entire life in France. We spoke to some of those affected.

item.title: French grammar tip: When to use the preposition à vs de
item.description: The French prepositions 'à' and 'de' are two of the most common (and confusing!) to use - here's how to figure out which one is appropriate when you are speaking French.
